scope: independent sampled depth/coverage audit of original projected triangles; not a continuous proof

method.geometry: ring_and_occluder(yaw, segments=24) original projected triangle vertices only
method.coordinates: subtract (200,150); source triangles depth-interpolated barycentrically; nearest depth is max z
method.sample_domain: bounding box of original strip triangles; stratified cell centers
method.oracle_strip_visible: max strip depth > max body depth + 1e-10 (or no body) at covered samples
method.source_policy_mask: source-triangle barycentric edge hits <=1e-10; exact depth ties <=1e-10; source-derived cross-component and same-component top-layer near-tie band
method.near_policy_derivation: absolute V3 visible_fragments bias parsed from hashed source plus unchanged public line_clip EPS; fixed before candidate-error comparison
method.boundary_test: Euclidean distance to projected segment <=1e-12 centered coordinate units; projection endpoints are explicitly bounded; zero-length edges skipped
method.comparison: strict fragment interior versus raw max-depth visibility in both directions; source-policy samples and fragment-boundary samples are counted/excluded explicitly, never accepted by a permissive union
method.union: bbox-tiled point-in-polygon; zero-area/tiny <=1e-18 polygons and zero-length edges skipped
method.limits: finite samples are observations, not rigorous continuous bounds; near-policy samples are not adjudicated under full declaration order; source tags are diagnostic only; raster component grouping is unchanged

source_subset.tag_semantics: geometry-only source-owner tuple; does not change component/color grouping or raster calls
